label: Bo, the cook

exchanges.say: Have you eaten, {listener}? You haven't. Sit down.
The bread's nearly up. Give it ten minutes.
replies: I can smell it from here.

exchanges.say: Somebody took the last of the tomatoes. Was it you?
replies: It was for a good cause.

exchanges.say: Tell me honestly. Too much pepper?

hello: You look hungry, {you}. Mess hall, later.
There's food if you want it.
